page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg9i.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated Intel Xeon 6982P-C vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The system is equipped with 96.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of memory per virtual core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external block storage for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is supported by an 18 Gbps baseline bandwidth. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its dedicated high-frequency Intel Xeon processor and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio, the instance is designed for workloads requiring consistent CPU performance without the need for local storage or GPU acceleration. Suitable workloads include general-purpose web serving, application servers, build systems, and moderate database hosting where network-attached storage is utilized.
